_about: Colours tools/rando/parity/appearance.py gives item holders (crates, lift rocks, chest pedestals) per placement, as the three per-placement colour multipliers GameModelController_GeneralInstanceParam0..2 (red, green, blue) the object's material multiplies its albedo by. 1.0 1.0 1.0 is the plain look; vanilla uses up to 1.82 on rocks, 1.75 on crates and 3.0 on candle sticks (data/rando/appearance_objects.json vanilla_tints). OoTR's categories: 'unchecked' is textures_unchecked's golden look; the rest are textures_content / chest textures (major = OoTR's gilded chest, bosskeys = its boss-key chest, keys = silver key chest, tokens = skull/web chest, hearts = heart chest).
